name: Circuit Theory
summary: The first circuits course: Kirchhoff's laws, nodal and mesh analysis, network theorems and the transient response of RC, RL and RLC circuits.

topics.name: Circuit variables, elements and sign conventions; independent and dependent sources
Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's voltage and current laws
Series-parallel reduction, voltage and current dividers
Network theorems (Thevenin, Norton, superposition, maximum power transfer)
The operational amplifier as a circuit element
Capacitors and inductors: energy storage and i-v relations
First-order RC and RL circuits: natural and step response
Second-order RLC circuits: overdamped, critically damped and underdamped response
